assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: three-frame horizontal sprite strip for a children's tennis exercise animation, IT34 fast lateral shuffle.
Input images: image 1 and image 2 are character and rendering style REFERENCES, not edit targets.
Use EXACT SAME fictional eight-year-old boy: brown short tousled hair, brown eyes, youthful child proportions, blue short-sleeve shirt, navy shorts, barefoot; match references. White seamless background.
Create ONE image containing exactly THREE equal square cells side by side, overall 3:1 aspect ratio. No cell borders, no text, no arrows, no logos. Full body with generous white margins in each cell, identical fixed frontal camera, identical scale, identical ground baseline and lighting. Every frame shows same child with soft bent knees, chest facing camera, hands naturally forward.
Frame1: neutral tennis ready stance, feet hip-to-shoulder width apart, centered.
Frame2: small controlled lateral shuffle to image-left: leading foot steps sideways, trailing foot follows, feet remain apart and never cross, body still faces forward; knees softly bent, no deep lunge.
Frame3: mirror movement to image-right with the other leading leg, equally short shuffle, feet apart.
This illustrates quick continuous shuffling between nearby flat marks, NOT a jumping squat, not a running stride, no crossed legs. Leave feet fully visible, keep head height and apparent head size consistent across all three frames. No equipment, no mat, no floor markings: clean white background and subtle small ground shadow only.
Style: polished friendly 3D instructional illustration matching reference boy. Frame spacing must allow algorithmic extraction and registration.

Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: three-frame horizontal sprite strip for children's tennis exercise animation IT35, alternating single-foot steps over a floor line and back.
Input images 1 and 2: character and rendering style references only. Exact same fictional eight-year-old boy, brown hair and eyes, blue T-shirt, navy shorts, barefoot, polished 3D instructional illustration.
One 3:1 horizontal image with exactly THREE equal square cells, no borders, labels, arrows or text. Pure white background, fixed THREE-QUARTER frontal camera so forward steps are unmistakable. Full child visible with generous identical margins, same head scale and same ground plane in all cells. A thin flat straight BLUE line spans most of each cell's floor horizontally at precisely the SAME position. No mat, no other objects.
Movement is one foot forward across line and BACK, then the OTHER foot forward across line and BACK, not both feet advancing together. Three key poses:
1 NEUTRAL: both feet just behind the line, soft knees, hip-width stance, hands ready in front, body upright with small athletic lean.
2 LEFT FOOT FORWARD: child's LEFT foot has made a SMALL step over line, flat forefoot safely on the near side of line, while RIGHT foot remains behind line. Hips/head mostly stay centered, both knees soft. Very short step, NOT a deep lunge.
3 RIGHT FOOT FORWARD: child's RIGHT foot has made the equally SMALL step across line while LEFT foot is back behind line. Mirror leg action without turning body or camera.
All panels depict same safe low stepping drill. Feet must be visible and their placement relative to blue line unambiguous. Knees track toes, no jumping, no crossed feet, no exaggerated stride. Keep facial identity, camera perspective, head height and scale consistent. Subtle small shadows only.
assets.correction: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached three-panel exercise strip. Keep the first and second panels EXACTLY unchanged. Fix ONLY the leg pose in the THIRD (rightmost) panel: currently it repeats the same left-foot-forward pose as panel2. In panel3, the boy's RIGHT foot (the foot on the LEFT side of that panel as viewed by us) must be FORWARD across the blue line, toward the viewer. His LEFT foot (on the viewer's RIGHT side) must be BACK behind the blue line. This must visibly be the OPPOSITE leading leg from panel2. Small gentle forward step, not a lunge. Keep character face, shirt, shorts, arm posture, fixed frontal camera, body scale, line height, white backdrop, all panel widths and overall 3:1 canvas identical. No text or arrows. Do not add anything else.
assets.note: Initial output repeated the leading leg; corrected final third frame shows the other leg.
